One shared world state connects spatial memory, object interventions, and independently chosen camera trajectories.

THE CORE IDEA

A world state you can intervene in.

UniState places spatial memory and object interventions in one shared world state. Control objects and the camera independently, generate their consequences, and carry the updated state into the next rollout.

See the paper for the full method and training details.

INTERVENTIONS IN ACTION

One state. Many ways to shape the world.

Specify the motion you want; the model completes the surrounding dynamics. Videos show precomputed results.

PERSISTENT SCENE CHANGES

Change the scene. Leave. Come back.

The controlled bulldozer pushes a rock. After the updated scene is stored in memory, the camera leaves and revisits the area: the rock remains in its displaced position.

CONTINUED CONTROL ACROSS ROLLOUTS

Move the object. Move the camera. Then both.

First, move the excavator with the camera fixed. Next, move the camera while keeping the updated object pose. Finally, control both together. Each rollout continues from the preceding world state.

Object only → Camera only → Object + camera
